draw.tools.select.note: U:grid/draw: Select Objects (gridcraft draw.lasso: no pen or eraser, objects are picked by clicking them). Pressed while no Draw tool is picked.

draw.tools.lasso.note: U:grid/draw: Lasso Select: drag a loop on the sheet and the ink strokes inside it are selected (Delete removes them, dragging inside moves them). gridcraft's lasso only puts the pen away; the loop is Excel's.

draw.tools.penBlue.note: U:grid/draw: translated from gridcraft draw.pen (colour #1F5FC9, width 2); dragging on the sheet draws a stroke (draw.stroke). Pressed while it is the pen in use.

draw.tools.penBlack.note: U:grid/draw: translated from gridcraft draw.pen (colour #000000, width 2).

draw.tools.penRed.note: U:grid/draw: translated from gridcraft draw.pen (colour #D13B2F, width 2).

draw.tools.penHighlighter.note: U:grid/draw: a pen 12 px wide; strokes wider than 8 px are drawn and saved at 45% (a highlighter), as gridcraft's xlsx ink does.

draw.tools.eraser.note: U:grid/draw: translated from gridcraft draw.eraser: dragging over an ink stroke deletes it (draw.erase at each point).

draw.tools.addPen.pen.note: U:grid/draw: Add Pen offers Pen, Pencil and Highlighter; each picks that pen with its colour and width (the ribbon has the four fixed pens, so a pen is not added to a gallery).

draw.tools.drawWithTouch.note: U:grid/draw: the sheet takes the mouse and pen only, there is no touch input to switch on; hidden.

draw.convert.inkToShape.note: U:grid/draw: translated from gridcraft draw.inkToShape: an open stroke becomes a line; a closed one a rectangle, triangle or ellipse. Converts the lasso's strokes, else the selected stroke, else the last.

draw.convert.inkToMath.note: U:grid/draw: needs handwriting recognition and an equation object; gridcraft has neither; hidden.

draw.replay.inkReplay.note: U:grid/draw: replays the sheet's ink stroke by stroke in the order it was drawn (view state only; not in gridcraft, whose ribbon has no Replay).
